description: This file defines the QueueInterface interface for Drupal's queue system, specifying methods for queue item management such as creation, claiming, deletion, and queue initialization.

classes.name: QueueInterface
classes.description: Interface for a queue, outlining methods for queue item management and queue lifecycle operations.

methods.name: createItem
methods.description: Adds a queue item with arbitrary data to the queue.

methods.name: numberOfItems
methods.description: Provides an estimated count of items in the queue.

methods.name: claimItem
methods.description: Claims an item for processing, with a specified lease time.

methods.name: deleteItem
methods.description: Deletes a processed item from the queue.

methods.name: releaseItem
methods.description: Releases an item that could not be processed, making it available for others.

methods.name: createQueue
methods.description: Initializes the queue, e.g., creating necessary storage.

methods.name: deleteQueue
methods.description: Deletes the queue and all its items.
